violation_type.title: Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Accordion Safety Gates (26 TAC §746.2415(a)(3))
violation_type.short_title: Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Accordion Safety Gates
violation_type.typical_finding: In the infant room there was an accordion safety gate in the doorway to enter the infant classroom, accordion safety gates are prohibited equipment for infants.    NOTE: This was corrected at inspection when caregiver removed the safety gate from the doorway and put it away in a storage room.

finding_variants.text: In the infant room there was an accordion safety gate in the doorway to enter the infant classroom, accordion safety gates are prohibited equipment for infants. An accordion gate was used in the infant room to block entry. Note: This was corrected at inspection when it was removed.
